item.content:encoded: I feel like the first entry was better, though this at least gives a second perspective to the whole conflict. I really appreciate the sections of notes. Far too often, journal writing is done with narrative in mind, rather than the mindset of the person writing at the time. This is still good, you just posted the better story first, in my opinion. :)
